premises.text: The travel planning process is complicated by too many irrelevant sources and options.
premises.evidence_span: Millions of sources and services have made a smooth travel planning process impossible Too often we're stuck with content totally irrelevant to us and too many options leave us totally paralyzed

premises.text: Mapify integrates various travel services into a single platform.
premises.evidence_span: a platform that integrates everything you've just seen into one single platform

premises.text: Mapify allows travelers to create and share visualizations of their travel journeys.
premises.evidence_span: a platform enabling travelers anywhere to access create and share visualizations of entire travel journeys

premises.text: Mapify uses an AI content engine to match travel experiences with user preferences.
premises.evidence_span: Everything you've just seen is based on an AI content engine we've built matching hundreds of thousands of tags With photos text and attachments to translate spots into relevant experiences

premises.text: The millennial leisure travel market is a significant segment worth around 150 billion dollars.
premises.evidence_span: The millennial leisure travel market is one of the largest travel market segments ever We're focusing on monetizing the European subsegment first worth around 150 billion dollars

premises.text: Mapify has already generated revenue through brand and affiliate partnerships.
premises.evidence_span: We are already generating revenue through brand and affiliate partnerships with some of the world's leading travel brands

value.text: Travel planning becomes easier and more personalized through Mapify.
value.evidence_span: Mapify is your personal travel guide that lets you create your whole travel journey in just a few seconds

notes: No separate premises for traction metrics or investor affiliations.
